title: seL4 Is Free – What Does This Mean For You?
summary: Gernot Heiser presents seL4, a microkernel with a mathematical proof connecting security properties to the binary code, and explains what its open-sourcing means for users. It covers its roles as a microkernel, separation kernel and hypervisor.
why: Cited to explain what formal verification of seL4 guarantees, such as ruling out whole classes of bugs like buffer overflows.

quote.text: The whole talk is well worth a watch.
